original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-additive-filtered-finite-projective}
Let $P \in \text{Fil}^f(\text{Mod}_\Lambda)$ be filtered finite projective, and
$f : P \to P$ an endomorphism in $\text{Fil}^f(\text{Mod}_\Lambda)$. Then
$$
\text{Tr}(f|_P) =
\sum\nolimits_p \text{Tr}(f|_{\text{gr}^p(P)}).
$$
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a ring and $(P,F)$ a finitely filtered **left** $\Lambda$-module with each $\operatorname{gr}_F^p P$ finite projective over $\Lambda$. For a filtration-preserving $\Lambda$-linear endomorphism $f:P\to P$, the trace in $\Lambda^\natural$ equals $\operatorname{Tr}(f|_P)=\sum_p\operatorname{Tr}(\operatorname{gr}^p_F(f):\operatorname{gr}_F^p(P)\to\operatorname{gr}_F^p(P))$.
hypotheses:
Let $P \in \text{Fil}^f(\text{Mod}_\Lambda)$ be filtered finite projective, and
$f : P \to P$ an endomorphism in $\text{Fil}^f(\text{Mod}_\Lambda)$.
conclusions: Let $\Lambda$ be a ring and $(P,F)$ a finitely filtered **left** $\Lambda$-module with each $\operatorname{gr}_F^p P$ finite projective over $\Lambda$. For a filtration-preserving $\Lambda$-linear endomorphism $f:P\to P$, the trace in $\Lambda^\natural$ equals $\operatorname{Tr}(f|_P)=\sum_p\operatorname{Tr}(\operatorname{gr}^p_F(f):\operatorname{gr}_F^p(P)\to\operatorname{gr}_F^p(P))$.
